title: XY16 X preservation saves $p as defined after a call clobbered its flags
summary: MOSInsertREPSEP::preserveX decides whether its PH $p reads a defined status register from backward liveness. A scavenger status-register save elsewhere in the loop makes N/Z look live across blocks, so after a JSR that clobbered them preserveX emits PH $p without undef and the machine verifier rejects it. Found as the one candidate-only failure of the near-index proof replay on the extracted upstream series (boids.c, XY16). Given the IR carrying the recovered nuw flags, the prerequisite alone, the candidate and the downstream compiler all fail identically; the same source compiles on the downstream compiler because its earlier passes produce different IR. Only machine verification rejects it; without -verify-machineinstrs the object is emitted.

Recovered-IR reproduction first reported by the independent reviewer of the near-index proof packet (docs/pr-preparations/2026-09-29/near-index-proofs/independent-review.md) and replayed by the recorder.
unknowns: No repair attempted. The fix belongs in preserveX, shared by 0002 and the #321 prerequisite; the scavenger P save that makes N/Z appear live is also patch-1 code.
No census source input reproduces it on the downstream compiler or on the prerequisite alone; other downstream inputs were not searched.

prior_work.source_assessment: preserveX SaveAP sets PLive from LivePhysRegs.contains(C|N|Z|V) after stepping backward from block live-outs and emits PH $p with undef only when PLive is false. The extracted prerequisite and 0002 have identical code for it.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Failing extracted candidate llc c8fb18cb is frozen in build/near-proof-upstream/candidate/bin. On the original IR, the same llc with recovery disabled, the patch-1-only llc b8006489 and downstream build/llvm-mos/bin/llc exit 0. On IR produced by the candidate up to and including recovery (boids.xy16.recovered.ll, 40 nuw GEPs), patch-1-only, candidate and downstream llc all exit 134 with the same PH $p diagnostic when started after loop-reduce.
prior_work.decision: The related record repaired stale X reloads by adding preserveX; this record is a separate liveness defect in how preserveX saves P.

configuration.optimization: Os in the frozen IR; llc default -O2

additional_runs.result: All three compilers exit 134 with Using an undefined physical register at PH $p in main after MOS Insert REP/SEP. The defect needs only IR carrying the recovered flags, not the recovery pass itself. Independent review reached the same result.

truchet.c at clang -O3 with +mos-a16,+mos-xy16 (frontend clang-23 254624ba26462f49), compiled by llc -O3 -verify-machineinstrs: the current downstream llc f1fa50a225c36607 and the carry-pressure-contract candidate llc 6f303945beb17ab3 both exit 134 with 'Using an undefined physical register' on PH $p in main (%bb.205 and %bb.296) after MOS Insert REP/SEP. Without -verify-machineinstrs both compile it. The candidate changes only 8-bit-mode pressure sets, so this XY16 input is outside its reach. Recorded as a repeat sighting of this defect's signature; the mechanism was not re-derived for this input.
